title_en: Delta Air Lines Abruptly Cancels 1-Hour Airbus A350 Route: See Map Now
title_zh: 达美航空突然取消 1 小时空客 A350 航线：立即查看地图
summary: The airline had scheduled the type on the route on just three occasions only.
summary_zh: 该航空公司仅在该航线上安排过该机型三次。
body_en: Prachi is a London-based journalist with extensive experience in the aviation industry. She has worked for several leading industry publications, covering a broad range of topics. Her expertise lies in aircraft maintenance, emerging technologies, and advanced air mobility. She is currently pursuing a PhD in Journalism, focusing on data journalism and its potential to transform conventional aviation reporting.

US airlines regularly deploy widebody aircraft on domestic routes , especially between major hubs and airports with significant connecting traffic. According to scheduling data from aviation analytics provider Cirium , thousands of domestic widebody flights are scheduled between December and October next year. Delta Air Lines alone has scheduled more than 17,000 domestic widebody flights, including around 660 operated by the Airbus A350-900.

One of the shortest routes on which the airline had planned to deploy the aircraft was the roughly one-hour flight between Harry Reid International Airport (LAS) in Las Vegas and Los Angeles International Airport (LAX). However, in its latest weekend schedule update, the SkyTeam member removed the A350 from that sector.
Delta Drops Planned A350-900 Operations From Las Vegas To Los Angeles

Delta had scheduled the A350-900 on the Las Vegas-to-Los Angeles route on just three occasions in January 2027. It was originally assigned to DL39 on January 4 and 5, departing Las Vegas at 7:05 PM and arriving in Los Angeles at 8:22 PM. A third service, operating as DL8783, was scheduled for January 3 with the same departure and arrival times.

According to AeroLOPA , the Atlanta-based carrier has two configurations of its A350-900 aircraft. The first accommodates 306 passengers, with 32 business class seats, 48 premium economy seats and 226 economy seats. The second has 275 seats, comprising 40 in business class, 40 in premium economy and 195 in economy. Delta had planned to deploy the latter configuration.
Delta Has Scheduled Additional Airbus A350 Flights For CES 2027

The planned A350-900 deployment may have been linked to the Consumer Electronics Show (CES), an annual technology trade show taking place in Las Vegas from January 6 to 9. The event attracts visitors from around the world, and Delta is increasing service to the city to meet expected demand.

The airline has confirmed it will operate more than 120 flights per day during the peak of CES 2027, connecting Las Vegas with major business markets in the US and overseas. Its plans include additional domestic frequencies and new nonstop international services from Hong Kong International Airport (HKG) and Taipei International Airport (TPE), two major Asian technology markets. Both routes will be operated by A350 widebody aircraft.
1 (Jan. 9); the other is planned for January 10 but using the A330-300

Cirium scheduling data also shows several other A350-900 flights planned to and from Las Vegas around the event, including services to Seoul Incheon International Airport (ICN), Paris Charles de Gaulle Airport (CDG) and Shanghai Pudong International Airport (PVG). The airline has also scheduled individual flights to Minneapolis–Saint Paul International Airport (MSP) and Salt Lake City International Airport (SLC), which may be related to aircraft positioning for its CES operations.
Delta Dominates Airbus A350 Departures From The US

Delta is one of the largest operators of the A350-900. According to ch-aviation , the airline currently operates a fleet of 43 aircraft of the type and is awaiting deliveries for 16 more (along with 20 A350-1000s). For January 2027, it has scheduled nearly 800 departures from US airports, with Los Angeles and Hartsfield–Jackson Atlanta International Airport (ATL) accounting for much of this activity.

Los Angeles is scheduled to see around eight to nine daily A350-900 departures most days, and Atlanta will see between seven and nine departures. By route, Atlanta to Seoul Incheon is the busiest, with two daily flights using the aircraft. This is followed by the domestic service between Atlanta and Los Angeles, where Delta has scheduled up to two daily A350-900 flights.
body_zh: Prachi 是一位驻伦敦记者，在航空业拥有丰富的经验。她曾在多家领先的行业出版物工作，涵盖广泛的主题。她的专长在于飞机维护、新兴技术和先进的空中机动能力。她目前正在攻读新闻学博士学位，专注于数据新闻及其改变传统航空报道的潜力。
美国航空公司定期在国内航线上部署宽体飞机，特别是在主要枢纽和具有大量转机流量的机场之间。根据航空分析提供商 Cirium 的调度数据，明年 12 月至 10 月期间将安排数千架国内宽体航班。仅达美航空就安排了超过 17,000 趟国内宽体航班，其中约 660 趟由空客 A350-900 运营。
该航空公司计划部署这架飞机的最短航线之一是拉斯维加斯哈利·里德国际机场 (LAS) 和洛杉矶国际机场 (LAX) 之间大约一小时的航班。然而，在最新的周末时刻表更新中，天合联盟成员将 A350 从该航段删除。
达美航空放弃 A350-900 从拉斯维加斯飞往洛杉矶的运营计划
达美航空在 2027 年 1 月期间仅将 A350-900 执飞了 3 次拉斯维加斯至洛杉矶航线。该航班最初于 1 月 4 日和 5 日分配给 DL39，于晚上 7:05 从拉斯维加斯出发，晚上 8:22 抵达洛杉矶。第三趟航班为 DL8783，定于 1 月 3 日出发，出发和到达时间相同。
据 AeroLOPA 称，这家总部位于亚特兰大的航空公司拥有两种配置的 A350-900 飞机。第一架可容纳306名乘客，其中包括32个商务舱座位、48个豪华经济舱座位和226个经济舱座位。第二架设有 275 个座位​​，其中商务舱 40 个、豪华经济舱 40 个、经济舱 195 个。达美航空原计划部署后一种配置。
达美航空已为 2027 年国际消费电子展 (CES) 安排了额外的空客 A350 航班
计划中的 A350-900 部署可能与消费电子展 (CES) 有关，这是 1 月 6 日至 9 日在拉斯维加斯举行的年度技术贸易展。该活动吸引了来自世界各地的游客，达美航空正在增加对该市的服务以满足预期需求。
该航空公司已确认将在 2027 年 CES 高峰期间每天运营超过 120 个航班，连接拉斯维加斯与美国和海外的主要商业市场。其计划包括增加国内航班频率以及从香港国际机场 (HKG) 和台北国际机场 (TPE) 这两个亚洲主要技术市场出发的新直达国际服务。这两条航线都将由 A350 宽体飞机运营。

Cirium 调度数据还显示，活动期间计划往返拉斯维加斯的其他几架 A350-900 航班，包括飞往首尔仁川国际机场 (ICN)、巴黎戴高乐机场 (CDG) 和上海浦东国际机场 (PVG) 的航班。该航空公司还安排了飞往明尼阿波利斯-圣保罗国际机场 (MSP) 和盐湖城国际机场 (SLC) 的个别航班，这可能与其 CES 运营的飞机定位有关。
达美航空主导空客 A350 从美国出发的航班
达美航空是 A350-900 最大的运营商之一。据ch-aviation 称，该航空公司目前运营着一支由 43 架该型飞机组成的机队，并正在等待交付另外 16 架飞机（以及 20 架 A350-1000 飞机）。 2027 年 1 月，该公司已安排近 800 架次从美国机场出发的航班，其中洛杉矶和哈茨菲尔德-杰克逊亚特兰大国际机场 (ATL) 占据了大部分航班。
洛杉矶大部分时间每天有大约 8 到 9 班 A350-900 出发，亚特兰大将有 7 到 9 班出发。从航线来看，亚特兰大飞往首尔仁川的航线最为繁忙，每天有两趟航班使用该飞机。其次是亚特兰大和洛杉矶之间的国内航班，达美航空每天安排多达两班 A350-900 航班。

title_en: Why United Airlines Is The Only US Carrier Left With An Overseas Hub
title_zh: 为什么联合航空是唯一一家拥有海外枢纽的美国航空公司
summary: Exploring the operations of United's Guam hub.
summary_zh: 探索美联航关岛枢纽的运营。
body_en: Daniel comes to Simple Flying with a business focused approach to the aviation world. Daniel enjoys analyzing strategy and how companies move against each other to gain a step ahead in the skies. Besides strategy, Daniel also has a passion for aircraft design and the history of aviation.

In general, the US legacy carriers primarily operate their networks within the continental US. All of American Airlines' ten hub airports are located within the continental US, as are all of Delta's nine hub airports. United Airlines , however, has seven hub airports in the continental US, as well as a hub in Guam, an overseas territory of the US located thousands of miles away from Washington. It's the only such operation by any US airline, and it carries on the legacy of an operation that goes back nearly 60 years.

United currently operates up to 12 daily flights to 15 different destinations in five countries out of Guam Antonio B. Won Pat International Airport (GUM). It is the start/end for the carrier's famous 'Island Hopper' service, and the airline also runs direct services from GUM to San Francisco with a stopover in Honolulu. This route uses a Boeing 777-300ER, while the rest of the GUM routes use the Boeing 737. United is by far the largest airline serving Guam, and it also serves as a vital link connecting Guam to the outside world.

In 1968, Continental Airlines and regional shareholders established Air Micronesia, initially headquartered in the Northern Mariana Islands. Operating under the callsign 'Air Mike', the airline initially operated Boeing 727s and became a crucial component in the region's economic development during the late 20th century. Air Micronesia held a near monopoly in the market, and its 727s were crucial in connecting what were previously remote islands to the outside world.

Continental would eventually own 100% of Air Micronesia, rebranding the airline to 'Continental Micronesia' while the headquarters eventually shifted to Guam. While other airlines attempted to connect Guam to the US at certain points and others served Micronesia from foreign countries, Continental Micronesia was by far the largest airline in this market. Among its most famous routes was the 'Island Hopper', connecting Guam to Honolulu with five stopovers, and the airline also had a substantial international network.

In 1999, Continental Micronesia began transitioning from using the 727 to the 737NG for most operations, and in 2003, the Guam International Airport Facility pushed commuter airlines out of GUM's Commuter Terminal and leased the facility to Continental. The airline would become Guam's largest private-sector employer, while connecting GUM to over 20 destinations.

In 2010, Continental Airlines announced that it would merge with United Airlines , keeping the United name. In 2017, Continental Micronesia was formally merged into United Airlines (it had previously operated as a subsidiary of United Continental Holdings), and today, all Guam flights are directly operated by United.

Airlines are hardly afraid of shutting down unprofitable hubs, and United itself dehubbed the Cleveland hub that it also inherited from Continental during the merger in 2014. However, the Guam operations were making money for the airline, and they're a vital link to the communities served. In addition, United absolutely dominates Guam, and the hub offers a unique strategic position within the carrier's network that couldn't otherwise be replicated by another hub.

Guam itself is a hub for lucrative military and government activity, and United's position in Guam means that it essentially receives all government travel contracts. Because of the airline's dominance in GUM, it can also charge high fares due to the lack of competition. Altogether, Guam is actually one of United's most lucrative hubs, even if it is also one of its smallest. The operation makes the airline money, and so it will remain a United hub, even as other US legacy carriers have dehubbed their hubs outside of the US mainland.
Guam Antonio B. Won Pat International Airport (GUM)
Houston George Bush Intercontinental Airport (IAH)
Washington Dulles International Airport (IAD)

In March 2026, the carrier began transitioning from using the 737-800 to the 737 MAX 8 for its Guam operations, with the switch having been completed in October. These ten aircraft feature a significantly upgraded interior compared to the old 737-800s, and they feature signs in English and Japanese rather than English and Spanish, while the front row of economy can be collapsed to accommodate a stretcher for medevac flights. In addition, two United First seats are blocked on the Island Hopper to be used as a pilot crew rest facility.
The Fate Of The Other Overseas Hubs Operated By US Airlines

Going into the 2010s, United Airlines and Delta Air Lines both operated hubs at Tokyo Narita International Airport (NRT). These hubs had operated for decades (Delta inherited NRT operations from Northwest Airlines, while United acquired the NRT routes from Pan Am) and essentially connected US passengers to Asia, serving as a central hub. But in the mid-2010s, United gradually discontinued intra-Asia routes out of NRT, and Delta exited NRT entirely in 2020 (it will return in 2027 with a single route from Seattle).

Whereas United's Guam hub primarily serves the local market, the NRT hubs operated by United and Delta mainly existed for connections . However, the arrival of the Boeing 787 and Airbus A350 allowed these airlines to serve more destinations in Asia nonstop from the US, and nonstop flights typically earn a fare premium over one-stop options. As such, the NRT hubs weren't necessary anymore, since they were essentially set up due to range limitations of older widebodies like the Boeing 747-200.

In addition to the improved economics of new widebody aircraft, United announced a joint venture with All Nippon Airways in 2011, while Delta announced a joint venture with Korean Air in 2017. With these, the intra-Asia routes are covered by their joint venture partners, eliminating the need to operate these flights with their own metal. In other words, United's NRT hub has been replaced by nonstop flights to Asia and ANA's operations out of Tokyo, while Delta's NRT hub has been replaced by Korean Air's hub in Seoul.

Apart from the carrier's one-stop flight from GUM to San Francisco via Honolulu with the 777-300ER, all of United's Guam routes now use the 737 MAX 8. There are currently ten of them stationed in GUM, and they operate to Taipei, Manila, Airai, Saipan, Yap, Pohnpei, Chuuk, Tokyo Narita, Tokyo Haneda, Osaka, and Nagoya. In addition, the airline's flight to Airai continues to Manila on some days of the week, while the flight to Chuuk is part of the Island Hopper, flying from Guam to Honolulu via Chuuk, Pohnpei, Kosrae, Kwajalein, and Majuro.
body_zh: Daniel 带着以商业为中心的方式进入航空界，加入了 Simple Flying。丹尼尔喜欢分析战略以及公司如何相互竞争以取得领先一步。除了战略之外，丹尼尔还对飞机设计和航空历史充满热情。
一般来说，美国传统运营商主要在美国大陆运营其网络。美国航空的所有 10 个枢纽机场均位于美国大陆境内，达美航空的所有 9 个枢纽机场也是如此。然而，联合航空在美国大陆拥有七个枢纽机场，并在距离华盛顿数千英里的美国海外领土关岛设有枢纽机场。这是美国航空公司中唯一一家开展此类业务的航空公司，并且继承了近 60 年前的运营传统。

目前，美联航每天运营多达 12 趟航班，从关岛安东尼奥·汪帕特国际机场 (GUM) 起飞，飞往 5 个国家/地区的 15 个不同目的地。这是该航空公司著名的“跳岛游”服务的起点/终点，该航空公司还运营从古姆百货公司飞往旧金山的直达航班，并在檀香山中途停留。该航线使用波音 777-300ER，而古姆百货公司的其余航线则使用波音 737。美联航是迄今为止服务关岛的最大航空公司，也是连接关岛与外界的重要纽带。
1968 年，美国大陆航空和地区股东成立了密克罗尼西亚航空，最初总部位于北马里亚纳群岛。该航空公司以“Air Mike”为呼号，最初运营波音 727 飞机，并成为 20 世纪末该地区经济发展的重要组成部分。密克罗尼西亚航空在市场上几乎处于垄断地位，其 727 飞机对于连接以前的偏远岛屿与外界至关重要。
美国大陆航空最终拥有密克罗尼西亚航空 100% 的股份，将该航空公司重新命名为“大陆密克罗尼西亚航空”，而总部最终迁至关岛。虽然其他航空公司试图在某些地点将关岛与美国连接起来，还有其他航空公司从国外为密克罗尼西亚提供服务，但大陆密克罗尼西亚航空公司是迄今为止该市场上最大的航空公司。其最著名的航线之一是“跳岛航线”，连接关岛和檀香山，经停五个站点，该航空公司还拥有庞大的国际网络。
1999 年，密克罗尼西亚大陆航空开始在大部分运营中从使用 727 过渡到使用 737NG。2003 年，关岛国际机场设施将通勤航空公司从古姆百货公司的通勤航站楼中挤出，并将该设施出租给大陆航空。该航空公司将成为关岛最大的私营部门雇主，同时将关岛与 20 多个目的地连接起来。
2010年，大陆航空宣布与联合航空合并，保留联合航空名称。 2017年，大陆密克罗尼西亚航空正式并入联合航空（此前曾作为联合大陆控股的子公司运营），如今，所有关岛航班均由联合航空直接运营。
航空公司并不害怕关闭无利可图的枢纽机场，美联航本身也取消了克利夫兰枢纽机场，该枢纽也是在 2014 年合并期间从大陆航空继承的。然而，关岛业务为该航空公司带来了利润，并且是与所服务社区的重要纽带。此外，美联航在关岛占据绝对主导地位，该枢纽在该航空公司的网络中具有独特的战略地位，这是其他枢纽无法复制的。
关岛本身就是利润丰厚的军事和政府活动的中心，美联航在关岛的地位意味着它基本上获得了所有政府旅行合同。由于该航空公司在古姆百货市场占据主导地位，因此也可以因缺乏竞争而收取高额票价。总而言之，关岛实际上是曼联最赚钱的枢纽之一，尽管它也是最小的枢纽之一。这项业务为航空公司带来了收入，因此它将继续作为美联航的枢纽，尽管其他美国传统航空公司已将其枢纽中心移至美国大陆以外。
关岛安东尼奥·汪帕特国际机场 (GUM)
休斯敦乔治布什洲际机场 (IAH)
华盛顿杜勒斯国际机场 (IAD)
2026 年 3 月，该航空公司开始在关岛运营中从使用 737-800 过渡到使用 737 MAX 8，转换已于 10 月完成。与旧型 737-800 相比，这 10 架飞机的内饰进行了显着升级，它们的标志是英语和日语，而不是英语和西班牙语，而经济舱的前排可以折叠起来，以容纳医疗救护航班的担架。此外，Island Hopper 上还预留了两个美联航头等舱座位，用作飞行员休息设施。
美国航空运营的其他海外枢纽的命运

进入 2010 年代，联合航空和达美航空均在东京成田国际机场 (NRT) 运营枢纽。这些枢纽已经运营了数十年（达美航空继承了西北航空公司的 NRT 业务，而美联航则从泛美航空收购了 NRT 航线），基本上将美国乘客与亚洲连接起来，充当了中心枢纽的角色。但在 2010 年代中期，美联航逐渐停止了从 NRT 出发的亚洲内部航线，而达美航空则在 2020 年完全退出了 NRT（将于 2027 年回归，只有一条从西雅图出发的航线）。
美联航的关岛枢纽主要服务于当地市场，而美联航和达美航空运营的 NRT 枢纽则主要用于转机。然而，波音 787 和空客 A350 的到来使这些航空公司能够从美国直飞亚洲更多目的地，而且直达航班通常比一站式航班赚取更高的票价。因此，NRT 枢纽不再是必要的，因为它们本质上是由于波音 747-200 等老式宽体飞机的航程限制而设置的。
除了提高新型宽体飞机的经济性外，美联航于 2011 年宣布与全日空航空公司成立合资公司，而达美航空则于 2017 年宣布与大韩航空成立合资公司。由此，亚洲区内的航线将由其合资伙伴覆盖，从而无需使用自己的金属来运营这些航班。换句话说，美联航的 NRT 枢纽已被飞往亚洲的直达航班和全日空从东京起飞的航班所取代，而达美航空的 NRT 枢纽已被大韩航空在首尔的枢纽所取代。

除了美联航使用 777-300ER 从古姆百货经檀香山飞往旧金山的一站式航班外，美联航在关岛的所有航线均使用 737 MAX 8。目前有 10 架飞机驻扎在古姆，运营飞往台北、马尼拉、爱拉伊、塞班岛、雅浦、波纳佩、特鲁克、东京成田、东京羽田、大阪和名古屋的航班。此外，该航空公司飞往艾拉伊的航班会在一周中的某些日子继续飞往马尼拉，而飞往特鲁克的航班是 Island Hopper 的一部分，从关岛飞往檀香山，途经特鲁克、波纳佩、科斯雷、夸贾林环礁和马朱罗。

title_en: Considering The Bilt Palladium Card? Here’s Why You Should Apply Soon…
title_zh: 考虑使用比尔特钯卡？这就是为什么你应该尽快申请......
summary: Bilt is changing how cardmembers earn in 2027, but if you open the Bilt Palladium Card by December 31, 2026, you can lock in the old system.
summary_zh: Bilt 正在改变持卡会员在 2027 年的收入方式，但如果您在 2026 年 12 月 31 日之前开通 Bilt 钯卡，则可以锁定旧系统。
body_en: The Bilt Palladium Card ( learn more ) is the most premium card in the Bilt credit card portfolio , and personally, it’s one of my all-around favorite cards ( Rates & Fees ). If you’ve been on the fence about picking up this very lucrative card, I’d highly recommend applying ASAP, and definitely before the end of 2026. Let me explain…
The Bilt Palladium Card is incredibly lucrative

The Bilt Palladium Card is one of my favorite credit cards , and it’s the card that gets the most of my spending . Just to cover some of the very basics, the card has a $495 annual fee ( Rates & Fees ), and offers the following value proposition at the moment
The Bilt Palladium Card has a welcome bonus of 50,000 points and Bilt Gold status after spending $4,000 within the first 90 days (on non-housing purchases), plus $300 Bilt Cash upon approval
The Bilt Palladium Card offers 2x points per dollar spent, plus 4% back in the form of Bilt Cash

The Bilt Palladium Card offers $200 in Bilt Cash annually as an anniversary bonus of sorts, and up to $400 in Bilt travel portal hotel credit every calendar year (this comes in the form of a $200 semi-annual statement credit, valid for a two-night minimum stay)

The Bilt Palladium Card also offers a Priority Pass membership, with up to two guests allowed (authorized users also receive a membership). A maximum benefit amount and certain restrictions and limitations apply. Please review ( the Mastercard Guide to Benefits ) for details.

For me, the logic of picking up this card is pretty straightforward, and I’ve shared that in much more detail . The idea is that the combination of the 2x points plus 4% back in the form of Bilt Cash is an unrivaled return on spending, especially given the value of Bilt points. Spending on Bilt cards also earns you Bilt elite status , and that unlocks better Rent Day promotions .

On the most basic level, that Bilt Cash earns me 1x points per dollar spent on my housing payments (without any sort of fee), plus I take advantage of the Points Accelerator feature, which earns me an extra 1x points per dollar spent up to five times per year, by redeeming $200 in Bilt Cash. In other words, this card earns me 3x points on up to $25,000 of spending per year, plus I’m being rewarded on my housing spending.

Points with Bilt rack up really quickly , so if you spend quite a bit on credit cards, I do think this is tough to beat. And this doesn’t even account for the value of the hotel credit, as you can stack the credit card’s hotel credit with some Bilt Cash to get an even bigger discount on a hotel stay.
The Bilt Palladium Bilt Cash opportunity ends soon

As I’ve covered, changes are coming to Bilt as of 2027 . While the changes are being made in the name of “simplifying” things, I’d argue that it only creates even more complexity, at least for existing members. Essentially, starting in 2027, Bilt members will earn points for their housing payment as a percentage of their card spending, in lieu of earning 4% back in Bilt Cash on all their spending.

The good news is that through December 31, 2026, you can still opt into the old system for being rewarded, and that will then be honored in 2027 and beyond. This applies both to existing cardmembers, and those who pick up the card before then, and select this as their earnings preference.
The idea is that if you opt into this grandfathered system and have the Bilt Palladium Card
You’ll continue to earn 4% back on your spending in the form of Bilt Cash, and you can redeem that Bilt Cash for everything from housing payments, to the Points Accelerator feature, to hotel credits

You’ll continue to earn up to $400 in hotel credits per year, which you can stack with some Bilt Cash for hotel redemptions, rather than just automatically having that credit amount converted into Bilt Cash (which reduces your flexibility to stack credits)

Just as an example, I have more Bilt Cash than I can redeem (at least as someone who is scared of helicopters , and who finds Blacklane to be overpriced even with the Bilt Cash redemption options ). However, the Bilt Cash I earn gets me 1x points on all my housing payments, maxed out Points Accelerator redemptions, elevated Rent Day offers, and Lyft and Walgreens redemptions, so I get $120 in credit with each business per year.

I think the Bilt Palladium can still absolutely be worth it under the new system, where you’d be rewarded on housing payments per the below, and would also earn $600 in Bilt Cash annually (starting in 2027), but without the 4% back in the form of Bilt Cash on spending.

Points on housing Minimum everyday spend as a % of monthly rent / mortgage (Example of $2,000 rent) 0.5x points Spend at least 25% of monthly rent ($500) 0.75x points Spend at least 50% of monthly rent ($1,000) 1x points Spend at least 75% of monthly rent ($1,500) 1.25x points Spend the same or more as your monthly rent ($2,000)

title_en: Lufthansa Management Threatens To Massively Shrink Airline, Lay Off Employees
title_zh: 汉莎航空管理层威胁要大规模缩减航空公司规模、裁员
summary: Lufthansa management is reportedly proposing to shrink its mainline fleet and shift regional flying to Lufthansa City Airlines, as pilot strike threats loom and labor trust erodes.
summary_zh: 据报道，由于飞行员罢工威胁，汉莎航空管理层提议缩减其干线机队，并将支线航班转移给汉莎城市航空
body_en: Lufthansa is the “flagship” airline of Lufthansa Group, yet somehow, is the least profitable airline in the whole organization . 2026 was supposed to be an exciting turnaround year for Lufthansa, as it’s even the carrier’s 100th anniversary .

Unfortunately things haven’t turned out so great. Earlier this year, the carrier dealt with massive labor issues, and back-to-back-to-back strikes . Just a few months ago, the company’s senior management claimed it wanted to turn over a new leaf with labor relations , and stop fighting with employees, so that it could find long term solutions.

How is that working out? Well, Lufthansa pilots are just days from possibly being able to strike again, no agreement has been reached for long term peace with employees, and management is threatening to massively shrink its mainline operation. In other words, it’s just another day at Lufthansa!
Lufthansa threatens employees with huge job cuts, again

Lufthansa and its pilots have been in negotiations for quite some time over the future of the company. As you’d expect, broadly speaking, negotiations revolve around pay and future flying opportunities. As you’d expect at any airline, employees want as much flying as possible, and as big of a fleet as possible, since that’s what maximizes their compensation.

The issue with Lufthansa Group management is that the company’s solution to everything is to simply create new, low cost subsidiaries. And if Lufthansa Group management doesn’t like the terms with its subsidiaries, then it just shuts down the subsidiaries and creates new ones.

So that brings us to the current issue. Essentially, Lufthansa’s problem is that the airline doesn’t make money on short haul flights, given high costs and intense competition. So we’ve seen the carrier increasingly outsourcing this flying to Lufthansa City Airlines, a subsidiary with lower operating costs , operating the same kinds of planes as you’ll see in the mainline fleet.

Lufthansa is asking its pilots to accept wage freezes, and is promising a certain level of career development opportunities. Pilots aren’t happy with what’s being proposed, so what’s Lufthansa’s solution?

Management is reportedly proposing a new plan to the supervisory board, which would see the core Lufthansa brand massively reduce its regional flying, and largely outsource this to lower cost operations, like Lufthansa City Airlines. The idea would be to make Lufthansa primarily a long haul airline, and then have much of the short haul flying be operated by a subsidiary.

Lufthansa’s mainline fleet currently consists of 260+ planes, with another 120+ planes on order. One proposal would see the mainline fleet reduced to 100 long haul aircraft and 100 short haul aircraft, with other planes being assigned to Lufthansa City Airlines.

One radical proposal could even see Lufthansa exclusively have a long haul fleet and ditch short haul flying, though it’s noted that this isn’t the most likely scenario, and it could take several years for something like that to be implemented.

Keep in mind that going back to 2017, Lufthansa had guaranteed pilots a minimum fleet size of 325 aircraft, but it terminated that agreement at the end of 2021. So it’s really hard for employees to trust any promises by management, when they can just be terminated.

There’s no denying that labor relations can be incredibly challenging, and that the economics of intra-Europe flying are also tough, when you have competitors like Ryanair, though Lufthansa doesn’t face nearly as much competition on that front as other carriers. Then again, Frankfurt (FRA) and Munich (MUC) aren’t exactly massively leisure destinations either.

Most airline employees want their company to succeed, and just want to be compensated fairly. Admittedly economics don’t always align. But what I find incredibly toxic is the approach taken by Lufthansa management. Let’s compare it to a marriage (which I think is a fair way to view the relationship between management and employees, since they’re “stuck” with one another).

Lufthansa’s approach is to constantly threaten employees by saying that “if you don’t do what we want, we’ll just get rid of you.” That’s simply not a good faith way to approach things. Why would Lufthansa employees trust management, when they’ve repeatedly torn up contracts, and shown employees they simply don’t care? It would be like threatening to leave your spouse every time you have an issue, rather than trying to find a solution.

Nothing against Lufthansa Group CEO Carsten Spohr personally, but I don’t understand how the board thinks he’s the best person for the job. Where’s the accountability for the endless management mistakes that have horribly impacted Lufthansa’s bottom line? Lufthansa’s employees are paying the price for the lack of success that comes as a result of all of Lufthansa’s errors, from the botched Allegris rollout, to Lufthansa’s very bad luck with new aircraft orders.

And before anyone says “oh, but the unions,” contrast what has happened at Lufthansa Group to what has happened at Air France-KLM , under the leadership of Ben Smith. Smith has now been CEO at Air France for over eight years, and there hasn’t been a single strike under his leadership. Under the previous Air France-KLM CEO, there were endless strikes, and the situation got so bad that senior executives were being chased up a fence and having their clothes ripped off.

This shows that good labor relations absolutely can happen, balancing the needs of employees and the company. But it requires showing employees that you actually care about the company and their future. What was one of Smith’s first orders of business when he took the job at Air France-KLM? He eliminated Joon, the low cost carrier at the airline that was supposed to basically be a labor arbitrage opportunity. That was a way to show employees how much he respected them, and that he wanted a fair agreement, rather than one that would undermine them.

Meanwhile Spohr’s solution to literally everything is to just threaten to start new subsidiaries or shut down existing subsidiaries. The irony is that Spohr started his career as a pilot, so you’d think he’d have respect for employees, having been on the other side. But clearly once he became senior management, his love for aviation turned into disdain for employees.

A few months ago, Lufthansa management claimed it wanted to turn over a new leaf when it comes to labor relations. That didn’t last long, because now the airline is back to its “do what we say or we’ll create a new subsidiary” approach.
body_zh: 汉莎航空是汉莎集团的“旗舰”航空公司，但不知何故，却是整个组织中利润最低的航空公司。 2026 年对于汉莎航空来说应该是激动人心的转型年，因为这甚至是该航空公司成立 100 周年。
不幸的是事情并没有那么好。今年早些时候，该航空公司处理了大规模的劳工问题和连续的罢工。就在几个月前，该公司高层还声称要在劳动关系上翻开新的一页，停止与员工的争斗，从而找到长远的解决办法。
效果如何？汉莎航空的飞行员距离可能再次罢工仅几天时间，尚未与员工达成长期和平协议，管理层威胁要大幅缩减其干线运营。换句话说，这只是汉莎航空的又一天！
汉莎航空再次威胁员工大幅裁员
汉莎航空及其飞行员已经就公司的未来进行了相当长的谈判。正如您所期望的那样，从广义上讲，谈判围绕薪酬和未来的飞行机会展开。正如您在任何航空公司所期望的那样，员工希望尽可能多地飞行，并拥有尽可能大的机队，因为这就是最大化他们的薪酬的原因。
汉莎航空集团管理层的问题在于，该公司解决一切问题的办法就是简单地创建新的低成本子公司。如果汉莎航空集团管理层不喜欢其子公司的条款，那么它就会关闭子公司并创建新的子公司。
这让我们想到了当前的问题。从本质上讲，汉莎航空的问题在于，由于成本高昂和竞争激烈，该航空公司无法在短途航班上赚钱。因此，我们看到该航空公司越来越多地将航班外包给汉莎城市航空，这是一家运营成本较低的子公司，运营着与干线机队相同类型的飞机。
汉莎航空要求其飞行员接受工资冻结，并承诺提供一定程度的职业发展机会。飞行员对提议的内容并不满意，那么汉莎航空的解决方案是什么？
据报道，管理层正在向监事会提出一项新计划，该计划将使汉莎航空的核心品牌大幅减少其支线航班，并将其大部分外包给汉莎城市航空等成本较低的运营商。这个想法是让汉莎航空主要成为一家长途航空公司，然后让子公司运营大部分短途航班。
汉莎航空的干线机队目前拥有 260 多架飞机，另有 120 多架飞机正在订购中。其中一项提议是将干线机队减少至 100 架长途飞机和 100 架短途飞机，其他飞机则分配给汉莎城市航空公司。
一项激进的提议甚至可以让汉莎航空专门拥有一支长途航班，而放弃短途航班，尽管有人指出，这不是最有可能发生的情况，而且可能需要几年的时间才能实施。
请记住，早在 2017 年，汉莎航空就曾向飞行员保证机队规模至少为 325 架飞机，但它在 2021 年底终止了该协议。因此，员工很难相信管理层的任何承诺，因为他们可以直接被解雇。
不可否认的是，当你有瑞安航空这样的竞争对手时，劳资关系可能会非常具有挑战性，而且欧洲内部飞行的经济状况也很艰难，尽管汉莎航空在这方面面临的竞争并不像其他航空公司那么激烈。话又说回来，法兰克福 (FRA) 和慕尼黑 (MUC) 也不完全是大型休闲目的地。
大多数航空公司员工希望他们的公司取得成功，并且只是希望获得公平的报酬。诚然，经济学并不总是一致的。但我发现汉莎航空管理层采取的做法极其有害。让我们将其与婚姻进行比较（我认为这是看待管理层和员工之间关系的一种公平方式，因为他们彼此“粘在一起”）。
汉莎航空的做法是不断威胁员工，说“如果你不按照我们的要求做，我们就会解雇你”。这根本不是一种善意的处理事情的方式。当汉莎航空公司的员工一再撕毁合同并向员工表明他们根本不在乎时，他们为什么会信任管理层呢？这就像每次遇到问题时都威胁要离开你的配偶，而不是试图找到解决方案。
就我个人而言，我并没有反对汉莎航空集团首席执行官卡斯滕·斯波尔（Carsten Spohr），但我不明白董事会为何认为他是这份工作的最佳人选。层出不穷的管理失误严重影响了汉莎航空的利润，责任在哪里？汉莎航空的员工正在为由于汉莎航空的所有错误而导致的失败付出代价，从糟糕的 Allegris 推出到汉莎航空在新飞机订单方面的运气不佳。
在有人说“哦，还有工会”之前，先将汉莎集团发生的情况与本·史密斯领导下的法航-荷航集团发生的情况进行对比。史密斯担任法航首席执行官已有八年多了，在他的领导下没有发生过一次罢工。在前法荷航首席执行官的领导下，罢工无休无止，情况变得如此糟糕，以至于高级管理人员被赶到栅栏上，衣服被扯掉。
这表明良好的劳资关系绝对可以发生，平衡员工和公司的需求。但这需要向员工表明你真正关心公司和他们的未来。史密斯在法航荷航集团就职后的首要任务是什么？他取消了 Joon 航空公司的低成本航空公司，这本来应该是一个劳动力套利机会。这是向员工表明他是多么尊重他们的一种方式，并且他想要一份公平的协议，而不是一个会损害他们的协议。
与此同时，斯波尔对所有事情的解决方案实际上就是威胁开设新子公司或关闭现有子公司。具有讽刺意味的是，斯波尔的职业生涯是从飞行员开始的，所以你可能会认为他在另一边会尊重员工。但显然，一旦他成为高级管理人员，他对航空业的热爱就变成了对员工的蔑视。
几个月前，汉莎航空管理层声称希望在劳资关系方面翻开新的一页。这种情况并没有持续多久，因为现在该航空公司又回到了“按照我们所说的去做，否则我们将创建一个新的子公司”的做法。

title_en: Amex Blue Cash Everyday Review: A No Annual Fee Card With Solid Bonus Categories
title_zh: Amex Blue Cash Everyday 评测：一张无年费、红利类别丰富的卡
summary: The Amex Blue Cash Everyday earns 3% back at U.S. supermarkets, gas stations, and online retailers with no annual fee, but only 1% elsewhere.
summary_zh: Amex Blue Cash Everyday 在美国超市、加油站和在线零售商可赚取 3% 的返现，无需年费，但在其他地方只有 1%。
body_en: American Express is best known for its points-earning cards, but the Blue Cash Everyday® Card from American Express proves that Amex can do cash back well too.

If you’re looking for a simple card that earns a solid return at supermarkets, gas stations, and online retailers, this one is worth a look. It has no annual fee ( Rates & Fees ), a decent welcome bonus, a great intro APR offer, and some useful bonus categories that cover a good chunk of everyday spending.

This post is my in-depth Blue Cash Everyday Card review, so I’ll cover the bonus categories, the credits and perks, and how this card compares to both the Blue Cash Preferred® Card from American Express and the Citi Double Cash® Card .
Review: Learn more about the Blue Cash Everyday® Card from American Express
Amex Blue Cash Everyday Card summary & key details for November 2026
First, here’s an overview of the Amex Blue Cash Everyday benefits and value proposition, from fees, to rewards, to the welcome bonus
Blue Cash Everyday Card annual fee: $0 ( Rates & Fees )

Blue Cash Everyday Card welcome offer: You may be eligible for as high as $200 cash back after spending $2,000 in purchases on your new Card in the first 6 months. Welcome offers vary and you may not be eligible for an offer. Cash back is received as Reward Dollars, redeemable for statement credit or for other select options. Terms Apply.

Blue Cash Everyday Card benefits: Up to $7 in monthly statement credits for a subscription purchase at DisneyPlus.com, Hulu.com, or Stream.ESPN.com (Enrollment required), up to $15 in monthly statement credits for Home Chef meal kit subscriptions, Amex presale ticket access, car rental loss and damage insurance, and purchase protection

Blue Cash Everyday Card intro APR offer: Enjoy 0% intro APR on purchases and balance transfers for 15 months from the date of account opening. After that, your APR will be a variable APR of 19.74% - 28.74%
Blue Cash Everyday Card foreign transaction fee: 2.7% of each transaction after conversion to US dollars.
Best for: Earning cash back on everyday purchases without an annual fee

Blue Cash Everyday Card pros Blue Cash Everyday Card cons No annual fee Bonus categories all have an annual cap Useful bonus categories that align with everyday spending No option to convert cash back to points Long intro APR offer period Other cards are better for non-bonus spending Amex Blue Cash Everyday bonus, fees, & eligibility

Bids were solicited via the internet with one received. U.S. Army Contracting Command, Research Triangle Park, North Carolina, is the contracting activity (W911NF-17-D-0001). Selected U.S. military contracts for March 7, 2017 U.S. AIR FORCE Kelly Aviation Center LP , San Antonio, has been awarded a $1,001,978,024 indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract for KC-10 engine contractor logistic support. Contractor will provide engine teardown and overhaul, on-wing support/contract field teams, and engine parts and logistics. In addition, the contractor will provide all support required to fulfill this requirement, including but not limited to labor, materials, tools, equipment, parts, and transportation. Air Force Life Cycle Management Center, Tinker AFB, Oklahoma, is the contracting activity (FA8105-17-D-0002). U.S. NAVY Avian LLC , Lexington Park, Maryland, is being awarded an $11,402,443 cost-plus-fixed-fee contract to provide support for the Naval Air Warfare Center Aircraft Division’s Integrated System Evaluation Experimentation and Test Department (AIR-5.1). Services provided will include flight test engineering, programmatic, administrative, design, execution, analysis, evaluation, and reporting of tests and experiments of aircraft, unmanned air systems, weapons and weapons systems. The Naval Air Warfare Center Aircraft Division, Patuxent River, Maryland, is the contracting activity (N00421-17-C-0049). Selected U.S. military contracts for March 8, 2017 U.S. NAVY Sierra Nevada Corp. , Rancho, California, is being awarded a $30,995,905 modification to a previously awarded firm-fixed-price, cost-plus-fixed-fee, indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract (N00174-09-D-0003) to extend the ordering period and exercise Option Year 6 for the procurement and support of the transmitting set, countermeasures AN/PLT-5, to support explosive ordnance disposal personnel. The AN/PLT-5 is a man-portable system in support of the Joint Service Explosive Ordnance Disposal Counter Radio Controlled Improvised Explosive Device Electronic Warfare program. The Naval Surface Warfare Center Indian Head Explosive Ordnance Disposal Technology Division, Indian Head, Maryland, is the contracting activity. Vector Planning and Services Inc. , San Diego, is being awarded a potential $17,910,070 indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity, cost-plus-fixed-fee contract to provide cyberspace science, research, engineering, and technology integration. Support includes innovative technology assessment and development; rapid software development and prototyping; enabling capability training; security engineering; and cybersecurity risk management. This is one of four multiple-award contracts. All awardees will have the opportunity to compete for task orders during the ordering period. The Space and Naval Warfare Systems Center Pacific, San Diego, is the contracting activity (N66001-17-D-0117). Selected U.S. military contracts for March 9, 2017 U.S. MISSILE DEFENSE AGENCY Lockheed Martin Space Systems Co. , Sunnyvale, California, was awarded a $53,052,807 competitive cost-plus-fixed-fee contract for a 36-month period with no options for the Multi-Object Kill Vehicle Technology Risk Reduction (TRR) effort. This contract represents part of the Missile Defense Agency’s technology risk reduction strategy to improve performance and reduce risk for a gimbaled seeker assembly, integrated avionics assembly, component integration and testing, and an advanced seeker. The Missile Defense Agency, Huntsville, Alabama, is the contracting activity (HQ0147-17-C-0002). U.S. NAVY ViON Corp. , Herndon, California, is being awarded a $34,790,000 indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract to provide Capacity as a Service support to Space and Naval Warfare Systems Command (Spawar) Headquarters, Spawar System Center Pacific and Spawar System Center Atlantic. The Capacity as a Service acquisition model allows Spawar to more accurately scale, up and down, its information technology (IT) infrastructure to meet evolving mission requirements. Savings are realized through no up-front costs and a “pay as you go” acquisition model, reducing waste usually associated with overbuying of IT equipment to eventually meet an expectation of mission requirement. Under this contract, ViON is responsible for providing on-demand, on-premise computing, networking and storage solutions for a variety of systems and applications for the command’s research, development, testing and evaluation core infrastructures, laboratory and data center environments. This contract includes options, which if exercised, would bring the maximum contract value to $49,990,000. The Space and Naval Warfare Systems Command, San Diego, is the contracting activity (N00039-17-D-0003).
